ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a vertical wall on each of the left and right sides. Point O is located between the two walls and suspends the flowerpot, so point O is subjected to the downward gravitational force of the flowerpot; rope OA runs obliquely upward to the left from point O and connects to point A on the left wall, and its direction is fixed; rope OB initially runs horizontally to the right from point O and connects to point B on the right wall, and later its right end moves upward along the right wall to B′. In the figure, OB′ is represented by a dashed line obliquely upward to the right, so the elevation angle of OB relative to the horizontal line gradually increases. Then reason: Let the angle between OA and the left horizontal line be the fixed φ, and let the angle between OB and the right horizontal line be α, then α gradually increases from 0. For force equilibrium of point O, in the horizontal direction there is T_OB cosα = T_OA cosφ; in the vertical direction there is T_OA sinφ + T_OB sinα = mg. From the horizontal direction, T_OB = T_OA cosφ / cosα. Substituting into the vertical direction gives T_OA sinφ + T_OA cosφ tanα = mg, namely T_OA = mg / (sinφ + cosφ tanα). Since φ is fixed, and α gradually increases during the process in which the right end moves upward from B to B′, tanα increases, so the denominator sinφ + cosφ tanα increases, therefore T_OA gradually decreases.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：O点挂花盆，受重力向下；OA绳固定指向左上方墙上A点；OB初始水平指向右墙B点，随后右端沿右墙上移到B′，所以OB绳相对水平的仰角逐渐增大，而OA方向不变。设OA与左水平线的夹角为固定的φ，OB与右水平线的夹角为α，α从0逐渐增大。对O点列静力平衡：水平方向 T_OB cosα = T_OA cosφ；竖直方向 T_OA sinφ + T_OB sinα = mg。消去T_OB得 T_OA = mg / (sinφ + cosφ tanα)。由于φ固定，α在上移过程中一直增大，分母一直增大，所以F_OA一直减小。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左右各有一竖直墙，O点位于两墙之间并悬挂花盆，因此O点受到花盆向下的重力作用；OA绳从O点斜向左上方连到左墙A点，方向固定；OB绳开始从O点水平向右连到右墙B点，后来右端沿右墙上移到B′，图中用斜向右上的虚线表示OB′，所以OB相对水平线的仰角逐渐增大。再推理：设OA与左水平线的夹角为固定的φ，OB与右水平线的夹角为α，则α从0逐渐增大。对O点受力平衡，水平方向有 T_OB cosα = T_OA cosφ；竖直方向有 T_OA sinφ + T_OB sinα = mg。由水平方向得 T_OB = T_OA cosφ / cosα，代入竖直方向得 T_OA sinφ + T_OA cosφ tanα = mg，即 T_OA = mg / (sinφ + cosφ tanα)。由于φ固定，而α在右端从B上移到B′过程中逐渐增大，tanα增大，因此分母 sinφ + cosφ tanα 增大，所以T_OA逐渐减小。
method.model_answer: OA绳的拉力 F_OA 一直减小。
